notes.title: UNSTABLE Leaves Early Access!
notes.content:
UNSTABLE has officially left Early Access!

[previewyoutube=rjU5vy2CXB4;full][/previewyoutube]

UNSTABLE is a 3D action runner with spaceship flight simulation. Handle unique keyboard controls to avoid asteroids! Disintegrate obstacles with a plasma laser weapon! Beat Leaderboard! And get to the mysterious unknown! Will you master the chaos of an unstable spaceship?

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1821410/UNSTABLE/

UNSTABLE launched into early access almost two months ago (with a small break :)). At that time, there were only flat space and campaign levels. Since there several key things were added:

[h2]3 Gorgeous Maps[/h2]
The space is enormous - fly as long as you can and meet various gorgeous [i]spacescapes[/i] along your way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/cc7f17db1641f20688b81853be55cd129ddb6b47.gif[/img]

[h2]Endless mode with Leaderboard[/h2]
Try your best on your way to the best pilots!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/37a30f5de98de667587acc0b66f0438db4aa17dd.png[/img]

[h2]Juicy Flight Effects[/h2]
Experience the game with dynamic effects & lighting!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/f23468b6b4e012cba56c325ba897dcb7d639ddc5.gif[/img]

[h2]Immersive Main Menu[/h2]
Look around and interact directly with screens, gauges, and other equipment of the spaceship cockpit.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/6f4af59cda68c1e89622b93f6ccdaab6c7a73cb1.gif[/img]

[h2]Localization into 10 languages[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/ed7289eefc91e1423d73c36dd16c0ebca74aa0f3.png[/img]

[h2]Windows & Linux versions[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/6ecb0cd59338b9d3ce3d8b9a9181dd2f2cab3e80.png[/img]

[h2]Steam Achievements & Cloud saves support[/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/ab3a04dfb7552182b93be9efdc95ac3cd64a2dab.png[/img]

I'm very amazed at how this [i]experiment[/i] turned out. Big thanks to people in Reddit communities for their positive, supportive, constructive feedback. I wouldn't last without you!

Also, check out the list of changes:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/1821410/view/3110302192893902998

notes.title: 0.6.0 - Redesigned Menu | Endless Mode | Leaderboard
notes.content:
[h2][b]Redesigned Main Menu[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/6f4af59cda68c1e89622b93f6ccdaab6c7a73cb1.gif[/img]
Look around and interact directly with screens, gauges, and other equipment of the spaceship cockpit. Try yourself!

[h2][b]New Endless Mode[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/11c6e23d3cc10c43f786e3e7c9767014270e4e55.png[/img]
The space is endless, so is this mode. Default and Manual controls on your choice. How long will you thrive on flying through the obstacles?

[h2][b]Leaderboard[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/37a30f5de98de667587acc0b66f0438db4aa17dd.png[/img]
Try your best on your way to the best pilots!

In addition to these changes, the scope was slightly increased, and some bugs were fixed.

There will be a few more minor patches in the coming weeks before the full release. Balance improvements, new visual effects, bug fixes are coming.

notes.title: 0.5.0 - Space Views | Slow Motion | New Effects
notes.content:
[h2][b]Space Views[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/0c383d7fa300ee4872b9dc8b55caa3b10e7e48d5.gif[/img]
The space is enormous, so you will meet various gorgeous [i]spacescapes[/i] along your way.

[h2][b]Slow Motion[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/1147017bf5a064ef0d3201d2c4e55e6411dcb0e8.png[/img]
A new item appeared in the space. Catch it to boost your ship, so the time would look slowed in comparison with your speed for several seconds.

[h2][b]New Effects[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41544964/f23468b6b4e012cba56c325ba897dcb7d639ddc5.gif[/img]
Experience the game with new effects & lighting

In addition to these changes, the keyboard impact was slightly tweaked, and some bugs were fixed.

Hope these things will increase your joyfulness of flying through space! The next big update will be in a few weeks. And its goal is to bring endless run mode with score and leaderboard.

notes.title: Early Access Release 🥳 | 0.4.0 - Steam Integration
notes.content:
Hello! I'm excited to announce that the upgraded game from Brackeys Game Jam 2021.2 (yeah, the idea has gone too far...) is released as early access now!

[*] New menu for level selection
[*] Slight improvement of the tutorial
[*] Alert signs font changed
[/list]
